pages.title: Fuel Tanks and Fuels
pages.text: AeroIE fuel tanks can hold any fluid, but only fluids registered as propulsion fuel—or E-710 used for warp—can be consumed and displayed by the corresponding systems.$(br2)Each fuel has its own thruster force multiplier and consumption multiplier.$(br2)AeroIE provides two propulsion fuels by default: D-T Fuel and High-Energy Particle Fuel. D-T Fuel produces slightly less force but is consumed more slowly; High-Energy Particle Fuel produces slightly more force but is consumed faster.

pages.title: Capacity
pages.text: The three tank capacities are:$(br2)Small: 100 B$(br2)Medium: 1 kB$(br2)Large: 10 kB

pages.title: Adding New Fuels
pages.text: To make thrusters recognize a new fluid, create `data/vsie/thruster_fuels/<name>.json` in a data pack or mod resource.$(br2)The file must define `fluid` (the fluid ID), `thrust_multiplier` (the thruster force multiplier while using it), and `consumption_multiplier` (the fuel consumption multiplier).
